data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable prior accident year claims development of GBP 11.1m (2017 - GBP 17.3m) was experienced in 2018, spread across all lines of business, as a result of lower than expected claims development.

named_events.loss_description: 2018 losses emanating from Hurricanes Florence and Michael generated gross incurred claims of GBP 12.9m to the Syndicate and GBP 7.4m net after ceded reinsurance.
The Syndicate was also affected by the Marine Project Sassi loss that was a GBP 18.1m gross loss and GBP 1.5m net of ceded reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a favourable prior accident year reserve movement in 2018, releasing GBP 11.1m of reserves (approximately 2.8% of opening gross claims outstanding) attributable to lower-than-expected claims development across its lines of business. In the current year the Syndicate also recorded catastrophe and large loss activity including Hurricanes Florence and Michael (gross GBP 12.9m, net GBP 7.4m) and the Marine Project Sassi loss (gross GBP 18.1m, net GBP 1.5m), which were recorded separately from the favourable prior-year development.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable prior accident year claims development of GBP 11.1m (2017 - GBP 17.3m) was experienced in 2018, spread across all lines of business, as a result of lower than expected claims development.
2018 losses emanating from Hurricanes Florence and Michael generated gross incurred claims of GBP 12.9m to the Syndicate and GBP 7.4m net after ceded reinsurance.
The Syndicate was also affected by the Marine Project Sassi loss that was a GBP 18.1m gross loss and GBP 1.5m net of ceded reinsurance.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position liabilities (2017 comparative). Prior year development (GBP 11.1m) taken from the claims note narrative which explicitly states GBP 11.1m favourable prior accident year development; the narrative does not explicitly label this as gross vs net but presents it as a gross movement in the technical reserves note, so treated as gross. No LOB-specific prior year movement amounts provided, so per-LOB amounts are null. Claims development triangle (gross) is available and was used to cross-check but the narrative figure was used as primary source.
